definition_zh: 连贯的；前后一致的；黏合在一起的；相干的
definition_en: sticking together so that the parts form a connected, consistent whole
core_image: 许多散块被黏成一体，抽掉哪一块，整体就散架
scene: 这组词中， An editor taps a paragraph and says: This paragraph is clear, but the essay as a whole is not coherent yet.
sceneCN: 这里 coherent 是「（文章整体）连贯的、前后一致的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这一段本身清楚，但整篇文章还不够连贯。画面里是红笔、稿件和贴满便签的墙。

senses.title: Text: parts joined so the meaning flows
senses.titleCN: 连贯的：各部分接上，意思能流动
senses.definition: of speech or writing, logically connected and easy to follow
senses.definitionCN: （口语或文章）逻辑连接、容易跟上的
senses.example: Her essay is coherent from the first paragraph to the last.
senses.exampleCN: 她的文章从第一段到最后一段都很连贯。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant 'to stick together'. Sentences cohere when each one sticks to the next, so the reader can walk across the paragraph without a gap.
senses.whyCN: 那个拉丁动词本义是“黏在一起”。句子彼此黏住，读者就能走过整段而没有断口，这就是连贯。

senses.title: Argument: claims that hold each other up
senses.definition: of ideas or an argument, consistent with one another and forming a single case
senses.definitionCN: （观点或论证）彼此一致，构成一个整体主张
senses.example: The theory is coherent: every claim supports the next.
senses.exampleCN: 这个理论前后一致：每个主张都支撑下一个。
senses.why: Sticking together is not mere sequence but mutual support. In an argument each claim must adhere to the others, or the structure pulls apart when one is pressed.
senses.whyCN: 黏在一起不只是排成顺序，而是互相支撑。在论证里，每个主张都得附着在别的主张上，否则一压就散。

senses.title: Person: a mind whose words still connect
senses.titleCN: 表达清楚的：话还连得起来的人
senses.definition: of a person, able to think and speak in a clear, connected way
senses.definitionCN: （人）能够清楚、有条理地思考和表达的
senses.example: The patient was drowsy but coherent after the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 手术之后病人昏昏欲睡，但说话还有条理。
senses.why: When the mind holds together, its output holds together. A coherent patient is one whose thoughts still stick to one another, which is why doctors test coherence after sedation.
senses.whyCN: 思维黏得住，说出的话就黏得住。coherent 的病人是思想仍彼此相连的人，所以医生在麻醉后要测试“连贯性”。

senses.title: Waves: crests that keep the same step
senses.titleCN: 相干的：波峰始终踩着同一步点
senses.definition: of waves, having the same frequency and a constant phase difference, so they can interfere stably
senses.definitionCN: （波）频率相同、相位差恒定，因而能稳定干涉的
senses.example: Two coherent beams produce a stable interference pattern.
senses.exampleCN: 两束相干光产生稳定的干涉图样。
senses.why: Physics took the 'sticking together' image literally: wave crests that stay locked in step remain glued to one another over distance, so their pattern does not blur.
senses.whyCN: 物理学把这个“黏在一起”的意象照字面用了：波峰始终同步，就在长距离上彼此黏住，图样因此不会糊掉。

senses.title: Group: many wills acting as one body
senses.titleCN: 协调一致的：众多意志像一个身体那样行动
senses.definition: of a group or policy, united and consistent so that the parts do not work against each other
senses.definitionCN: （群体或政策）统一而一致，各部分不相互抵触
senses.example: The party needs a coherent policy on housing.
senses.exampleCN: 这个党需要一套协调一致的住房政策。
senses.why: A group is coherent when its members stick to one line. The physical image of parts adhering becomes social: no faction pulls away from the whole.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体在成员都黏在一条线上时才是连贯的。部分附着的物理意象变成社会意象：没有哪一派从整体上扯开。

senses.title: Substance: a mass that holds its shape
senses.titleCN: 黏合的：能保持形状的一团物质
senses.definition: of a material, sticking together firmly as a single mass
senses.definitionCN: （材料）牢固地黏成一团
senses.example: The wet clay stayed coherent enough to be shaped by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 湿黏土黏得足够结实，可以用手塑形。
senses.why: This is the oldest physical sense: particles that adhere to one another form a coherent mass. Everything abstract later borrows this picture of a body that does not crumble.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的物理义：相互附着的颗粒形成一团黏合的物质。后来一切抽象用法都借用了这个“不散架的身体”的图景。

senses.title: Laser light: one wavelength in lockstep
senses.titleCN: 相干光：步调一致的一束光
senses.definition: of light, having a single wavelength and a fixed phase relationship, as in a laser
senses.definitionCN: （光）波长单一、相位关系固定，如激光
senses.example: A coherent beam can carry a signal across a room without spreading.
senses.exampleCN: 相干光束能把信号送过房间而不发散。
senses.why: Ordinary light is a crowd of waves out of step; laser light is a column marching in step. Coherent here means the waves are so glued in rhythm that the beam stays narrow.
senses.whyCN: 普通光是步调杂乱的一群波；激光是齐步走的一列。这里的 coherent 指波在节奏上黏得如此紧，光束因此保持狭窄。

senses.title: Account: a story with no missing joints
senses.titleCN: 条理清楚的：关节齐全的叙述
senses.definition: of an account or explanation, orderly and intelligible, with no gaps in the sequence
senses.definitionCN: （叙述或解释）有条理、可理解，顺序上没有缺环
senses.example: He gave a coherent account of what happened that night.
senses.exampleCN: 他对那晚发生的事做了条理清楚的叙述。
senses.why: A story coheres when cause sticks to effect and each scene sticks to the next. Where a joint is missing, the listener feels the seam, and we say the account is incoherent.
senses.whyCN: 当因黏住果、每一幕黏住下一幕时，故事就连贯。缺一个关节，听者就摸到接缝，我们便说叙述不连贯。

senses.title: Strategy: a plan whose pieces agree
senses.titleCN: 成体系的：各块彼此呼应的计划
senses.definition: of a plan or set of actions, internally consistent and aimed at one goal
senses.definitionCN: （计划或行动组合）内部一致、指向同一目标
senses.example: The company lacks a coherent strategy for its overseas branches.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司对其海外分支机构缺乏一套连贯的战略。
senses.why: A strategy is coherent when its decisions stick to one aim; if each department pulls in its own direction, the plan has no single body to hold it together.
senses.whyCN: 当各项决策都黏在同一个目标上，战略才连贯；若每个部门各自拉扯，计划就没有一个整体来维持它。

intro.en: Coherent comes from Latin cohaerere, 'to stick together'. The physical sense of parts adhering is the source of every later sense: text, argument, group, mind and light all 'hold together'.
intro.cn: coherent 来自拉丁语 cohaerere“黏在一起”。部分附着的物理义是后来一切义项的源头：文章、论证、群体、心智、光，全都“黏得住”。

items.en: Cohaerere meant 'to stick together, be connected'. It was com- 'together' plus haerere 'to adhere, stick, cling'.
items.cn: cohaerere 意为“黏在一起、相连”，由 com-“一起”加 haerere“附着、黏住、紧贴”构成。

items.en: The adjective enters English as 'harmonious', a sense close to the Latin participle: things that fit and hold together without conflict.
items.cn: 该形容词以“和谐的”义进入英语，接近拉丁分词的意思：彼此贴合、黏在一起而不冲突。

items.en: By the 1570s it also meant 'sticking together' physically, and 'connected, consistent' of speech and thought.
items.cn: 到 1570 年代，它也表示物理上的“黏在一起”，以及言语和思想上的“连贯、一致”。

items.en: Optics and later physics adopted coherence for waves that keep a fixed phase relationship; a coherent beam is literally a set of waves marching in step.
items.cn: 光学及后来的物理学采用 coherence 指保持固定相位关系的波；相干光束字面上就是齐步走的一组波。

items.en: Modern usage extends the word to persons ('coherent after the accident'), to organizations and to policy, always asking whether the parts still hold together.
items.cn: 现代用法把该词扩展到人（“事故后神志清楚”）、组织与政策，问的始终是：各部分是否还黏得住。

items.en: Haerere itself is of uncertain origin. Watkins proposed PIE *ghais- 'to adhere', but some linguists reject the link and de Vaan offers no etymology, so the deepest step is source uncertain.
items.cn: haerere 本身来源不确定。Watkins 提出原始印欧语 *ghais-“附着”，但一些语言学家否定这一联系，de Vaan 也未给出词源，故最深层来源不确定。

note.en: The first group is chosen for spelling, the second for meaning, so that form and sense stay separate.
note.cn: 第一组按拼写挑选，第二组按词义挑选，这样词形和词义不会混在一起。

entries.definition: to stick together or be logically connected. It is the verb behind coherent.
entries.definitionCN: 黏合；连贯一致。它是 coherent 背后的动词。

entries.definition: the quality of being connected and consistent. It is the noun of coherent.
entries.definitionCN: 连贯性；一致性。它是 coherent 的名词。

entries.definition: not connected or not able to speak clearly. It is in- 'not' plus coherent.
entries.definitionCN: 不连贯的；语无伦次的。它是 in-“不”加 coherent。

entries.definition: sticking to a surface, or a supporter of a cause. It shares the Latin root haerere 'to stick'.
entries.definitionCN: 附着的；拥护者。它与 coherent 同出拉丁词根 haerere“黏住”。

entries.definition: always behaving or being stated in the same way. It stresses agreement over time rather than physical joining.
entries.definitionCN: 一致的；始终如一的。它强调时间上的相符，而非物理连接。

entries.definition: following clear rules of reasoning. It focuses on inference, while coherent focuses on the whole holding together.
entries.definitionCN: 合乎逻辑的。它聚焦推理规则，而 coherent 聚焦整体是否黏得住。

entries.definition: forming a united whole; tending to stick together. It is close to the physical and social senses of coherent.
entries.definitionCN: 有凝聚力的；黏合的。它接近 coherent 的物理义与社会义。

entries.definition: made into a single whole. It describes the result, where coherent describes the holding-together.
entries.definitionCN: 统一的；一体化的。它描述结果，而 coherent 描述黏合的状态。

entries.definition: expressed clearly and easy to understand. It matches the clarity of a coherent explanation but not its structure.
entries.definitionCN: 清晰易懂的。它对应连贯解释的清晰，但不涉及结构。

normalIntro.en: These links are real: Latin com- and haerere, the cohere family, and the derived forms English actually uses.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想都是真实的：拉丁语 com- 与 haerere、cohere 词族，以及英语实际使用的派生形式。

normal.en: coherent = co- 'together' + haerere 'to stick': the parts are glued, so the whole holds.
normal.cn: coherent = co-“一起”+ haerere“黏”：各部分被黏住，整体才立得住。

normal.en: The same haerere gives adhere, adherent and adhesion: all about one thing clinging to another.
normal.cn: 同一个 haerere 还给出 adhere、adherent、adhesion：都是关于一物紧贴另一物。

normal.en: coherence is what an essay, a policy and a laser beam can all have: the pieces keep the same step.
normal.cn: coherence 是文章、政策和激光束都能有的东西：各块保持同一步点。

normal.en: incoherent is in- 'not' + coherent: words that will not stick, so a drunk or a feverish person becomes incoherent.
normal.cn: incoherent 是 in-“不”+ coherent：话黏不起来，所以醉酒或发烧的人会语无伦次。

normal.en: Doctors ask a patient to count backwards to test whether the mind is still coherent.
normal.cn: 医生让病人倒着数数，就是测试他的思维是否还连贯。

abstract.en: The core operation is adhesion: separate pieces must grip one another before anything larger can exist.
abstract.cn: 核心动作是黏附：分开的块必须先互相咬住，更大的东西才可能存在。

abstract.en: The same grip is scaled to sentences, arguments, groups, minds and waves; in each case the test is whether a piece can be pulled away.
abstract.cn: 同一种咬合被缩放到句子、论证、群体、心智和波；每一次的检验都是：能否把某一块抽走。

abstract.en: So 'logical', 'consistent', 'unified' and 'in step' are not separate meanings but one question: does the whole still hold when pressed?
abstract.cn: 所以“合乎逻辑、前后一致、统一、同步”并非彼此无关，而是同一个问题：受压时整体还立得住吗？

examples.en: She gave a clear and coherent explanation of the new rules.
examples.cn: 她对新规则做了清楚而连贯的解释。

examples.en: The government has failed to produce a coherent energy policy.
examples.cn: 政府未能拿出一套协调一致的能源政策。

examples.en: The witness was too shaken to give a coherent account.
examples.cn: 那名证人受惊过度，无法做出条理清楚的叙述。

dict_mnemonic.text: co（一起）+ here（这里）+ ent——把所有材料都“一起放在这里”黏住 → coherent 连贯的

root: 源自拉丁语 cohaerere“黏在一起”，由 com-“一起”+ haerere“附着、黏住”构成，核心是“各部分黏成一体”。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of coherent, all traced to one act: parts sticking together. Sentences, claims, minds, waves, groups, clay, laser light, stories and strategies are all tested by whether their pieces still hold.
sensesIntro.cn: coherent 的九个义项都追溯到一个动作：各部分黏在一起。句子、主张、心智、波、群体、黏土、激光、故事与战略，检验的都是各块是否还黏得住。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: separate pieces adhering into one body that does not fall apart.
core.cn: 核心意象：分开的块黏附成一个不散架的整体。

branches.en: WORDS STICK: sentences joined into a flowing text, and events joined into an intelligible account.
branches.cn: 词句黏合：句子接成流动的文章，事件接成可理解的叙述。

branches.en: CLAIMS STICK: an argument whose claims support one another, and a strategy whose decisions serve one aim.
branches.cn: 主张黏合：论点彼此支撑的论证，以及决策服务同一目标的战略。

branches.en: THE MIND STICKS: a person whose thoughts still connect, the medical test of coherence.
branches.cn: 心智黏合：思想仍能相连的人，也就是医学上的连贯性测试。

branches.en: WAVES STICK: crests locked in phase, from interference patterns to a laser beam that does not spread.
branches.cn: 波黏合：波峰锁在同一相位，从干涉图样到不发散的激光束。

branches.en: BODIES STICK: clay that holds its shape, and a group whose members hold one line.
branches.cn: 形体黏合：保持形状的黏土，以及成员守同一条线的群体。

intro.en: Coherent is co- + haerere + -ent. Its family shows the prefix com-/co-, the root haer- 'stick', and the suffixes -ent, -ence, -sion and -ive.
intro.cn: coherent 是 co- + haerere + -ent。它的词族展示了前缀 com-/co-、词根 haer-“黏”，以及后缀 -ent、-ence、-sion、-ive。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb cohaerere 'to stick together' yields coherent, coherence and cohere. Its participle haesus gives cohesion, while adhaerere gives adhere and adherent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 cohaerere“黏在一起”给出 coherent、coherence、cohere。它的分词 haesus 给出 cohesion，而 adhaerere 给出 adhere 与 adherent。

items.meaningCN: 连贯的；一致的；黏合的（-ent 构成形容词）
items.example: The report is coherent and well argued.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告连贯且论证充分。

items.meaningCN: 连贯地；有条理地（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: He could not speak coherently after the fall.
items.exampleCN: 摔倒后他说话语无伦次。

items.meaning: the state of sticking together or being consistent
items.meaningCN: 连贯性；一致性；相干性（-ence 构成名词）
items.example: The essay lacks coherence between paragraphs.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章段与段之间缺乏连贯。

items.meaning: not connected; unable to speak clearly
items.meaningCN: 不连贯的；语无伦次的（in- 表否定）
不连贯；语无伦次（in- 表否定）
items.example: The incoherence of the plan worried investors.
items.exampleCN: 计划的不连贯让投资者担忧。

items.meaning: to stick together or be logically consistent
items.meaningCN: 黏合；连贯一致（动词原形）
items.example: The chapters cohere into a single story.
items.exampleCN: 这些章节黏合成一个完整的故事。

items.meaning: the act or state of sticking together; unity
items.meaningCN: 黏合；凝聚力（-ion 构成名词）
items.example: Sport builds cohesion within a team.
items.exampleCN: 运动能建立团队内部的凝聚力。

items.meaning: to stick fast to a surface or follow a rule closely
items.example: The tape adheres to damp surfaces.
items.exampleCN: 这种胶带能粘在潮湿表面。

items.meaning: sticking to something; a supporter of a cause
items.meaningCN: 附着的；拥护者（-ent 表人或形容词）
items.example: He is a loyal adherent of the old theory.
items.exampleCN: 他是旧理论的忠实拥护者。

items.meaning: to exist as a natural quality in something
items.exampleCN: 每一项投资都固有风险。

definition_zh: adj. 神的；神圣的；极好的 n. 牧师；神学家 v. 占卜；凭直觉发现
definition_en: of or like a god, treated as holy, extremely good, or to discover something by intuition
core_image: 一道落在石祭坛上的光柱；一本放在安静厅堂玻璃罩下的旧书；寒夜里第一勺热汤；一个身穿黑袍站在木讲道台上说话的人；一个拿着丫形树枝在干地上方探测的人
scene: 寒夜里她喝下第一勺热汤，眉毛都舒展开了。 The soup was simply divine.
sceneCN: 这里 divine 是「极好的」（第 3 个义项：极令人愉快的）；句意：这汤简直好极了。图中可辨识物件：冒着热气的汤碗、勺子、寒夜的窗、舒展的眉头。

senses.title: Belonging to a god
senses.definition: of, from or like a god
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）属于神、来自神或似神的
senses.example: The temple was built for divine worship.
senses.exampleCN: 这座庙是为敬神而建的。
senses.why: A shaft of light falling on a stone altar.
senses.whyCN: 一道落在石祭坛上的光柱。

senses.title: Holy and sacred
senses.definition: treated as holy and beyond ordinary life
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）被视为神圣、超乎日常生活的
senses.example: They promised to honour the divine law.
senses.exampleCN: 他们承诺遵从神圣的律法。
senses.why: A worn book kept under glass in a quiet hall.
senses.whyCN: 一本放在安静厅堂玻璃罩下的旧书。

senses.title: Extremely good
senses.definition: wonderful or very pleasing
senses.definitionCN: （形容词）极好、极令人愉快的
senses.example: The soup was simply divine.
senses.exampleCN: 这汤简直好极了。
senses.why: A first spoonful of hot soup on a cold night.
senses.whyCN: 寒夜里第一勺热汤。

senses.title: A clergyman
senses.definition: a priest or a scholar of theology
senses.definitionCN: （名词）神职人员或研究神学的学者
senses.example: The parish divine preached on patience.
senses.exampleCN: 教区牧师讲了一篇关于忍耐的道。
senses.why: A figure in a black robe speaking from a wooden pulpit.
senses.whyCN: 一个身穿黑袍、站在木讲道台上说话的人。

senses.title: Discover by intuition
senses.definition: to guess or find out something as if by magic
senses.definitionCN: （动词）像有魔法一样猜出或发现某事
senses.example: She divined the truth from his silence.
senses.exampleCN: 她从他的沉默中猜出了真相。
senses.why: A dowser holding a forked twig over dry ground.
senses.whyCN: 一个拿着丫形树枝在干地上方探测的人。

intro.en: Divine comes from Latin divinus, belonging to a god, from divus, godlike; what belongs to a god is holy, and what is holy feels wonderful, so the word slid into praise.
intro.cn: divine 来自拉丁语 divinus「属于神的」，源自 divus「似神的」；属于神的就是神圣的，神圣的东西让人觉得美妙，于是这个词滑进了赞叹语。

items.en: Latin divus means godlike or divine.
items.cn: 拉丁语 divus 意为似神的、神圣的。

items.en: Divinus means belonging to a god.
items.cn: divinus 意为属于神的。

items.en: Old French divin carries both holy and wonderful senses.
items.cn: 古法语 divin 同时带有神圣与极好的意思。

items.en: English divine first describes what belongs to God.
items.cn: 英语 divine 最初形容属于神的事物。

items.en: The noun comes to name a scholar of theology.
items.cn: 名词转而指研究神学的学者。

items.en: Divine is also a warm word for something delightful.
items.cn: divine 也成了形容极美妙事物的亲热说法。

note.en: Divine is of a god; its look-alikes share the god root or the shape of the word, and its neighbours name other degrees of holiness and beauty.

entries.definition: the state of being a god, or theology

definition_zh: 制造；加工制作；组装；编造；捏造；伪造
definition_en: to make something by putting parts or materials together, or to invent something false in order to deceive
core_image: 车间里钢板边被切齐，焊枪把两块料拼成一只支架，火花落在地上
scene: 工厂接到一张图纸，工人先下料再拼焊，第二天就交出一只临时支架。 The shop can fabricate a replacement bracket overnight.
sceneCN: 这里指按图纸把材料加工成实物（第 1 个义项：用材料制作实物）；句意为这家车间一夜之间就能做出一个替换支架。图中可辨识物件：钢板、切割机、焊枪、支架。

pos.zh: 制造；制作；编造；捏造；伪造

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「制造；捏造」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「制造者；捏造者」
由该动词加已然词尾构成，义为「加工好的；编造的」
由表示「预先」的前缀加该动词构成，义为「预制；预先加工」
由预制动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「预制加工」

senses.title: To make a thing from materials
senses.definition: to make a product by cutting, shaping or joining raw materials and parts
senses.definitionCN: 通过切割、成形或接合原料与零件来做出产品
senses.example: The workshop can fabricate a steel frame in two days.
senses.exampleCN: 这家车间两天就能造出一副钢架。
senses.why: The Latin word for a smith's shop supplied the idea of skilled making, and the verb still starts from material and hands.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语里表示铁匠铺的词给出了「手艺制作」的意思，这个动词至今仍从材料与双手出发。

senses.title: To fit parts into a whole
senses.definition: to assemble separate components into one finished structure
senses.definitionCN: 把分开的部件装配成一个成品结构
senses.example: They fabricate the frame from four welded sections.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用四段焊接件把这个框架拼成整体。
senses.why: Once the material is cut, the next step is joining, so the same verb covers assembly as well as shaping.
senses.whyCN: 材料切好之后下一步就是接合，因此同一个动词既指成形，也指装配。

senses.title: To invent a story
senses.definition: to invent an account or excuse that has no basis in fact
senses.definitionCN: 编造一个没有事实依据的说法或借口
senses.example: He fabricated a reason for missing the inspection.
senses.exampleCN: 他为错过检查编造了一个理由。
senses.why: Making and making up share the picture of building something out of pieces, and a lie is assembled the same way.
senses.whyCN: 「制造」与「编造」共享「用零件搭起来」的画面，谎言也是这样拼出来的。

senses.title: To forge a document
senses.definition: to produce a false document, signature or record that appears genuine
senses.definitionCN: 制作一份看起来真实、实为虚假的文件、签名或记录
senses.example: The clerk fabricated the safety certificate.
senses.exampleCN: 那名职员伪造了安全证书。
senses.why: A document is a made object, so faking one is described with the verb for making.
senses.whyCN: 文件也是被做出来的东西，因此伪造文件沿用了「制作」这个动词。

senses.title: To plant false evidence
senses.definition: to create or alter evidence so that an investigation reaches a false conclusion
senses.definitionCN: 制造或改动证据，使调查得出错误结论
senses.example: The report says the inspector fabricated the test results.
senses.exampleCN: 报告称检查员捏造了检测结果。
senses.why: Evidence is treated as a manufactured article, and the metaphor turns a lab record into a fabricated product.
senses.whyCN: 证据被当作一件制造出来的物品，这个比喻把实验记录变成了加工产品。

senses.title: To frame someone
senses.definition: to invent a charge or accusation against an innocent person
senses.definitionCN: 为无辜者编造罪名或指控
senses.example: They fabricated a complaint to remove him from the site.
senses.exampleCN: 他们编造了一纸投诉，把他赶出工地。
senses.why: The charge is built piece by piece like a machine, and the person is trapped inside it.
senses.whyCN: 罪名像机器一样被一件件拼起来，而人被关在这台机器里。

senses.title: To invent a theory
senses.definition: to put forward a concept or explanation without evidence, as if it were established
senses.definitionCN: 在没有证据的情况下提出一个概念或解释，仿佛它已经成立
senses.example: The paper fabricated a mechanism that no experiment supports.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇论文臆造了一个没有任何实验支持的机制。
senses.why: Academic writing inherited the word through its Latin sense of constructing, and construction without material is invention.
senses.whyCN: 学术写作经拉丁语「建造」义继承了这个词，而没有材料的建造就是臆造。

senses.title: To pre-make a component
senses.definition: to produce a standard part in a shop before it is moved to the building site
senses.definitionCN: 在工厂预先生产标准构件，再运到施工现场
senses.example: The supplier will fabricate the beams off site.
senses.exampleCN: 供应商会在场外预先把这些梁加工好。
senses.why: Modern construction splits making from placing, and the verb stays with the making half.
senses.whyCN: 现代建造把「制作」与「就位」分开，这个动词留在「制作」那一半。

senses.title: To generate a synthetic record
senses.titleCN: 合成伪造的影像或记录
senses.definition: to create an image, recording or dataset by technical means and present it as real
senses.definitionCN: 用技术手段生成图像、录音或数据集，并当作真实内容呈现
senses.example: The software can fabricate a convincing voice sample.
senses.exampleCN: 这款软件能合成一段以假乱真的语音样本。
senses.why: The newest extension keeps the oldest structure: pieces are arranged until the result looks like something that occurred.
senses.whyCN: 最新的这一层保留着最古老的结构：把碎片排列到看起来像真发生过一样。

intro.en: Fabricate comes from Latin fabricare, to make or fashion, from fabrica, a workshop or craft, and faber, a smith or artisan. English first used it for skilled making, then for making up lies.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 fabricare「制作、打造」，其名词 fabrica 指作坊或手艺，faber 指铁匠或工匠。英语先用它表示有手艺的制作，后来才引申为编造谎言。

items.en: Faber meant a smith or skilled worker, especially one who worked hard materials such as stone, metal or wood.
items.cn: 这个词指铁匠或有手艺的工匠，尤指加工石、金属、木材等硬质材料的人。

items.en: Fabrica named the workshop and the craft carried on there, so the place and the skill were one word.
items.cn: 这个词既指作坊，也指在作坊里进行的手艺，地点与技艺合为一体。

items.en: The verb meant to shape, build or construct, and it covered both ordinary products and elaborate structures.
items.cn: 这个动词意为塑造、建造、构造，既用于日常产品，也用于复杂的建筑。

items.en: English took the verb through French and used it first for the making of physical things by skilled labour.
items.cn: 英语经法语引入这个动词，最初用于表示以熟练劳动制作实物。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the verb also meant to invent a falsehood; the first attestation date of that shift is uncertain and is usually given only as the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，这个动词也指编造虚假内容；这一转变的首见年代不确定，通常只给十八世纪这一约数。

items.en: Metal fabrication made the word a trade term, and digital tools later extended it to synthetic images and records.
items.cn: 金属加工使这个词成为行业术语，数字工具后来又把它扩展到合成影像与记录。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like fabricate; the second group names neighbouring ideas of making and faking.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「fabricate」相近；第二组是与「制作、造假」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of making or the thing made, and also for a lie.
entries.definitionCN: 指制造行为、制成品，也指编造出来的谎言。

entries.definition: A person or firm that makes parts, or one who invents false accounts.
entries.definitionCN: 指加工零件的个人或企业，也指编造说法的人。

entries.definition: To make a standard part in a factory before it is taken to the site.
entries.definitionCN: 指在工厂预先制作标准构件，再运到现场。

entries.definition: Woven cloth, and by extension the frame of a building; the same workshop word turned into material.
entries.definitionCN: 指织物，也引申指建筑的结构骨架；是同一个作坊词转成的材料名。

entries.definition: Resembling a fable; it looks close but belongs to the word for story, not to the smith's shop.
entries.definitionCN: 指像寓言一样的；形近但属于「故事」那一系，与铁匠铺无关。

entries.definition: To make goods on a large scale, usually in a factory and by machinery.
entries.definitionCN: 指大规模制造商品，通常指工厂机械化生产。

entries.definition: To put components together into a finished unit.
entries.definitionCN: 指把部件装成一个成品。

entries.definition: To shape metal by heat and hammer, or to make a false document.
entries.definitionCN: 指加热锤打成形金属，也指伪造文书。

entries.definition: To alter a record or account so that it misrepresents the facts.
entries.definitionCN: 指改动记录或说法，使其歪曲事实。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the smith's shop behind the word, its real family and its real trade phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用这个词背后的铁匠铺、真实同族词与真实行业搭配。

normal.en: The Latin faber was a smith, and fabricate began as the work done at that forge.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 faber 是铁匠，fabricate 最初就是铁匠铺里做的活。

normal.en: Fabric, fabrication, fabricator and prefabricate all come from the same workshop word.
normal.cn: 织物、制造、制造者与预制都出自同一个作坊词。

normal.en: Metal fabrication is a real trade, covering cutting, forming and welding.
normal.cn: 金属加工是一门真实行业，涵盖切割、成形与焊接。

normal.en: Fabricate evidence and fabricate a story are the two fixed phrases of the false sense.
normal.cn: 捏造证据与编造故事是虚假义的两个固定说法。

normal.en: Prefabricated beams arrive on site already made, which is the word doing its literal work.
normal.cn: 预制梁到场时已经做好，正是这个词在字面意义上的用法。

abstract.en: Fabrication is construction with no material behind it: a frame of air that looks solid.
abstract.cn: 编造是没有材料支撑的建造：一副看起来坚固的空气骨架。

abstract.en: The same hand that shapes steel can shape a lie, and the word refuses to tell them apart.
abstract.cn: 塑钢的手也能塑造谎言，而这个词拒绝把两者分开。

abstract.en: Every false record is a product with a workshop, a process and a quality check.
abstract.cn: 每一份假记录都是有作坊、有流程、有质检的产品。

examples.en: The team will fabricate the guardrail from galvanised steel.
examples.cn: 这个班组会用镀锌钢加工护栏。

examples.en: He tried to fabricate an alibi for the night of the accident.
examples.cn: 他试图为事故当晚编造不在场证明。

examples.en: Inspectors found that the lab had fabricated three test reports.
examples.cn: 检查人员发现该实验室捏造了三份检测报告。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「法布瑞克特」——作坊里把料拼成件，件是真的叫制造，话是假的叫编造：制造、捏造

root: 拉丁语 fabricare「制作、打造」← fabrica「作坊、手艺」← faber「铁匠、工匠」；更早的词源属重构形式。英语十五世纪经法语引入，先指实物制作，十八世纪起兼指编造，确切年代来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses move from the smith's bench outward: making a product, joining parts, inventing a story, forging a document, planting evidence, framing a person, inventing a theory, pre-making a component, and generating a synthetic record.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项从铁匠台向外移动：制作产品、拼装部件、编造故事、伪造文书、捏造证据、诬陷他人、臆造理论、预先加工构件、合成伪造记录。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a smith joins cut pieces until a solid bracket stands on the bench.
core.cn: 核心意象：铁匠把切好的料拼在一起，直到一只结实的支架立在台上。

branches.en: THE LITERAL MAKING: raw material becomes a finished article under skilled hands.
branches.cn: 字面制作：原料在熟练的手下变成成品。

branches.en: THE JOINED AND PRE-MADE PART: components fitted into a whole, or built in advance off site.
branches.cn: 拼合与预制：部件被装成整体，或在场外提前做好。

branches.en: THE INVENTED ACCOUNT: a story built for a reason, and a charge built around a person.
branches.cn: 编造的说法：为某个理由搭起的故事，以及围着一个人搭起的罪名。

branches.en: THE FALSE PAPER: a certificate or a test record made to look genuine.
branches.cn: 假文件：做得像真的一样的一份证书或检测记录。

branches.en: THE CONSTRUCT WITHOUT MATERIAL: a theory with no evidence and a voice sample with no speaker.
branches.cn: 没有材料的构造：无证据的理论，以及无说话人的语音样本。

intro.en: Fabricate is a Latin verb whose stem sits inside a whole family of English making words.
intro.cn: 这是一个拉丁动词，其词干嵌在一整族英语「制作」词里。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies faber, fabrica and fabricare; the deeper root behind them is reconstructed rather than recorded, so it is listed as a reconstruction.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了铁匠、作坊与制作三个词；它们更早的词根属重构而非有记录的形式，因此按重构形式列出。

items.example: The smith gave the family its name.
items.exampleCN: 铁匠给了这一族词名字。

items.example: The place and the skill were named together.
items.exampleCN: 地点与技艺被同一个词命名。

items.example: The verb names the work of the shop.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指作坊里的活。

items.example: The ending marks the English verb of action.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾标明英语的动作动词。

items.meaning: the act or result of making
items.example: It forms the noun for the process and the lie.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示工序与谎言的名词。

items.example: The ending names the worker or the firm.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾指工人或企业。

items.example: It marks the part made before delivery.
items.exampleCN: 它标出交付前就做好的构件。

items.example: The workshop word became the cloth.
items.exampleCN: 作坊词变成了布料的名称。

items.example: The form is a reconstruction, not a recorded word.
items.exampleCN: 该形式是重构，不是有记录的词。

由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「制造者；捏造者」

definition_zh: adj. 灵巧的；熟练的；机敏的（手或头脑）
definition_en: able to use the hands or the mind quickly, accurately and skilfully
core_image: 一只手用镊子夹起一粒米，另一只手同时穿针；修表匠的指尖在齿轮间移动
scene: 她灵巧的手指修好了手表。 Her dexterous fingers fixed the watch.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：dexterous 指灵巧的；句意是她灵巧的手指修好了手表。

senses.title: Skilful with the hands
senses.definition: able to use the hands quickly and accurately
senses.definitionCN: 能快速准确地使用双手
senses.example: Her dexterous fingers fixed the watch.
senses.exampleCN: 她灵巧的手指修好了手表。
senses.why: Tweezers lifting a single grain of rice.
senses.whyCN: 镊子夹起一粒米。

senses.title: Quick and clever in mind
senses.definition: mentally quick and skilful in handling a problem
senses.definitionCN: 在处理问题时头脑敏捷而有办法
senses.example: The lawyer was dexterous in argument.
senses.exampleCN: 这位律师在辩论中十分机敏。
senses.why: A hand moving pieces ahead of the opponent.
senses.whyCN: 一只手抢在对手之前移动棋子。

senses.title: Done with neat skill
senses.definition: performed with neat and practised skill
senses.definitionCN: 以干净利落且熟练的技巧完成
senses.example: It was a dexterous piece of surgery.
senses.exampleCN: 这是一台做得精巧的手术。
senses.why: A stitch line so fine it barely shows.
senses.whyCN: 一条细到几乎看不出的缝合线。

intro.en: Dexterous comes from Latin dexter, on the right hand, which also meant skilful, because the right hand was the working hand.
intro.cn: dexterous 源自拉丁语 dexter（右手的），它也有「灵巧」的意思，因为右手是干活的手。

items.en: Dexter meant on the right hand.
items.cn: dexter 意为在右手的。

items.en: Dexteritas meant readiness and skill.
items.cn: dexteritas 意为敏捷与技巧。

items.en: Dexterous entered English for skilful.
items.cn: 十六世纪 dexterous 以灵巧义进入英语。

definition_zh: 宏观经济的；研究整体经济运行（国民产出、就业、物价总量）的
definition_en: relating to the whole economy, especially when it is studied through national totals rather than through single firms or households
core_image: 从高空俯瞰一个国家的经济：成千上万家店铺、工厂与住户缩成一张汇总表，总量曲线在纸面上缓缓起落
scene: 一个国家里有无数工厂、店铺与家庭，研究者把它们合成总量来观察。 The annual review offers a macroeconomic reading of output, employment and prices.
sceneCN: 前半情境：一个国家里无数工厂、店铺与家庭被合成总量来观察；句中的 macroeconomic 指「把整个经济作为总量来考察的」（第 1 个义项：以国民产出等全国总量为单位）。图中可辨识物件：汇总表格、起落的曲线、地图轮廓、计算器。

pos.zh: 宏观经济的；整体经济层面的

senses.title: Measured in national totals
senses.definition: relating to totals compiled for a whole country rather than for one firm or one household
senses.definitionCN: 与为整个国家编制的总量相关，而非针对单个企业或单个住户
senses.example: The study compares macroeconomic totals across three decades.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究比较了跨越三十年的宏观经济总量。
senses.why: the prefix for 'large' is attached to economic, so the adjective marks the scale at which the economy is observed: the whole rather than the parts.
senses.whyCN: 表示「大」的前缀加在「经济的」之上，这个形容词因而标出观察经济的尺度：看整体，不看局部。

senses.title: Belonging to the level of national policy
senses.definition: belonging to the level at which a government or central bank acts on the economy as a whole
senses.definitionCN: 属于政府或中央银行对整个经济采取行动的层面
senses.example: Interest rates and the budget are macroeconomic instruments.
senses.exampleCN: 利率与预算是宏观经济层面的工具。
senses.why: a tax rate or an interest rate moves millions of prices at once, so such levers act at the scale the word names.
senses.whyCN: 税率或利率一次牵动千百万个价格，这类杠杆正是在这个词所指的尺度上起作用。

senses.title: Treating the economy as one system
senses.titleCN: 把经济当作一个系统来处理的
senses.definition: approaching an economy as an interacting system of spending, production and trade instead of as separate units
senses.definitionCN: 把经济看成支出、生产与贸易相互作用的一个系统，而非彼此分离的单位
senses.example: Her macroeconomic model links consumption, investment and trade.
senses.exampleCN: 她的宏观经济模型把消费、投资与贸易联系起来。
senses.why: once the units are summed, what matters is how the sums feed back into one another, and the adjective names that system view.
senses.whyCN: 各单位一旦汇总，重要的是各总量如何互相反馈，这个形容词命名的正是这种系统视角。

senses.title: Concerned with growth and recession
senses.definition: concerned with the long swings of expansion, slowdown and recovery that a whole economy passes through
senses.definitionCN: 关注整个经济所经历的扩张、放缓与复苏等长期摆动
senses.example: The chapter explains macroeconomic swings between boom and slump.
senses.exampleCN: 这一章解释繁荣与萧条之间的宏观经济摆动。
senses.why: booms and slumps are visible only in aggregates, so the word naturally covers the study of such swings.
senses.whyCN: 繁荣与萧条只有在总量上才看得出来，因此这个词自然涵盖对这类摆动的研究。

senses.title: Used for cross-country comparison
senses.titleCN: 用于国与国之间的比较
senses.definition: used when the totals of different countries are set side by side
senses.definitionCN: 用于把不同国家的总量并排放置比较时
senses.example: Comparisons of macroeconomic performance depend on exchange rates and trade balances.
senses.exampleCN: 宏观经济表现的比较取决于汇率与贸易收支。
senses.why: a national total is the only unit that can be placed beside another national total, which is why the word travels across borders.
senses.whyCN: 只有全国总量才能与另一个全国总量并排比较，这个词因此能跨国使用。

senses.title: Tied to national accounts and indicators
senses.titleCN: 与国民账户和统计指标挂钩的
senses.definition: belonging to the statistical framework of national accounts, price indices and employment figures
senses.definitionCN: 属于国民账户、价格指数与就业数据这一统计框架
senses.example: Official macroeconomic statistics are revised every quarter.
senses.exampleCN: 官方的宏观经济统计每季度修订一次。
senses.why: the totals have to be counted somewhere, so the word also names the tables and indices that measure them.
senses.whyCN: 总量必须在某处被数出来，因此这个词也指测量这些总量的报表与指数。

senses.title: Describing risk that spreads through the system
senses.titleCN: 描述在系统内扩散的风险的
senses.definition: describing a strain or failure that spreads from one part of the economy to the whole system
senses.definitionCN: 描述从经济的一处扩散到整个系统的压力或失灵
senses.example: A bank failure can become a macroeconomic problem within weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 一家银行的倒闭可能在数周内变成宏观经济问题。
senses.why: the word's scale sense is applied to danger: what begins in one balance sheet can threaten every total in the accounts.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的尺度义被用到危险上：始于一张资产负债表的事，可能威胁账户里的每一个总量。

senses.title: Built into a whole-economy model
senses.titleCN: 构成整体经济模型的一部分
senses.definition: describing a model, forecast or simulation constructed at the level of the whole economy
senses.definitionCN: 描述以整个经济为单位构建的模型、预测或模拟
senses.example: The bank revised its macroeconomic forecast after the quarterly figures were published.
senses.exampleCN: 季度数据公布后，银行修订了它的宏观经济预测。
senses.why: a model built from national totals is called macroeconomic because its unit of construction is the whole system, not the single firm.
senses.whyCN: 由全国总量构建的模型之所以被称为宏观经济的，是因为它的构建单位是整个系统，而不是单个企业。

intro.en: The adjective joins a Greek prefix meaning 'large' to economic, which descends from Greek oikonomikos by way of Latin oeconomicus. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: 这个形容词把表示「大」的希腊前缀接在 economic 之前，而 economic 经拉丁 oeconomicus 来自希腊 oikonomikos。年代均为约数。

items.en: Makros meant 'long' and, by extension, 'large'. The reading 'large in scale' is generally thought to be the one that fed the modern prefix.
items.cn: makros 意为「长的」，并引申为「大的」。一般认为「尺度上的大」这一读法是现代前缀的来源。

items.en: Oikonomikos described the management of a household, built from oikos 'house' and nemein 'to distribute, manage'.
items.cn: oikonomikos 指家宅的管理，由 oikos「家宅」与 nemein「分配、管理」构成。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek adjective as oeconomicus, still attached to the estate and the household rather than to a state.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊形容词作 oeconomicus，仍附着于产业与家宅，而非国家。

items.en: English economic, borrowed in the seventeenth century, widened from household management to the wealth and trade of a nation.
items.cn: 英语 economic 于十七世纪借入，从家宅管理扩展到国家的财富与贸易。

items.en: In the twentieth century the combining form for 'large' was attached to economic to mark the scale of the whole economy.
items.cn: 到二十世纪，表示「大」的构词成分被接在 economic 之前，以标出整个经济的尺度。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the adjective is generally dated to the 1930s, when totals-based analysis took shape, but no precise first citation is established.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：一般认为这个形容词出现于二十世纪三十年代前后，与总量分析的兴起同步，但确切的首次书证尚未确立。

note.en: Group one lists words that share the same prefix but have nothing to do with money; group two lists terms that stand close in meaning or form the opposite scale.
note.cn: 第一组是同用这个表示「大」的前缀、却与经济无关的词；第二组是语义相近或构成相反尺度的说法。

entries.definition: The prefix for 'large' plus Greek kosmos 'world': the universe viewed as a single whole, with no economic content at all.
entries.definitionCN: 由表示「大」的前缀加希腊语「世界」构成：把宇宙看作一个整体，与经济毫无关系。

entries.definition: The same prefix plus Greek skopein 'to look': large enough to be seen with the naked eye, as in physics and biology.
entries.definitionCN: 同一前缀加希腊语「看」：大到肉眼可见，用于物理与生物学。

entries.definition: The prefix plus molecule: belonging to very large molecules such as proteins, a term of chemistry only.
entries.definitionCN: 前缀加「分子」：属于蛋白质一类的大分子，纯属化学术语。

entries.definition: The same economic base with the prefix for 'small': it studies single firms, households and single markets, the exact mirror of this word.
entries.definitionCN: 同样的经济词干配表示「小」的前缀：研究单个企业、住户与单个市场，正是本词的反面。

entries.definition: From Latin ad- 'to' plus grex 'flock': a figure formed by adding many units, which is the raw material of macroeconomic work.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁语中表示「向」的前缀加 grex「群」：把许多单位相加而成的数字，正是宏观经济工作的原料。

entries.definition: A transparent compound meaning 'across the whole economy'; it states the scope plainly, without the technical flavour of the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 一个意思透明的复合词，指「遍及整个经济」；它朴素地说明范围，没有该形容词的技术色彩。

entries.definition: From Latin fiscus 'purse': concerning government taxing and spending, one of the main instruments used at this scale.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 fiscus「钱袋」：关于政府征税与开支，是在这一尺度上使用的主要工具之一。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives rather than invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The prefix for 'large' plus 'of the economy' gives a word for the economy seen at full scale.
normal.cn: 表示「大」的前缀加上「经济的」，得到的是把经济整体放大来看的词。

normal.en: The family runs macroeconomic, macroeconomics, macroeconomist, macroeconometric.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 macroeconomic、macroeconomics、macroeconomist、macroeconometric。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: macroeconomic policy, macroeconomic stability, macroeconomic indicators.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：宏观经济政策、宏观经济稳定、宏观经济指标。

normal.en: It forms a pair with microeconomic: same base, opposite prefix, whole versus part.
normal.cn: 它与 microeconomic 构成一对：同样的词干，相反的前缀，整体对部分。

normal.en: The phrase macroeconomic aggregates is a reliable signal, because aggregates are exactly what the word studies.
normal.cn: 「宏观经济总量」这一搭配是可靠信号，因为总量正是这个词研究的对象。

abstract.en: Picture an aerial photograph in which millions of separate transactions blur into one rising curve.
abstract.cn: 想象一张航拍照片，千百万笔分散的交易模糊成一条上升的曲线。

abstract.en: Picture a doctor reading a whole-body temperature chart instead of one finger's warmth.
abstract.cn: 想象医生看的是全身的体温曲线，而不是一根手指的温热。

abstract.en: Picture a weather map covering a continent where you can no longer find your own street.
abstract.cn: 想象一张覆盖整个大陆的天气图，上面再也找不到自己那条街。

examples.en: Macroeconomic analysis treats inflation and unemployment as connected totals.
examples.cn: 宏观经济分析把通胀与失业看作相互关联的总量。

examples.en: The central bank raised rates for macroeconomic reasons rather than to protect one industry.
examples.cn: 央行加息是出于宏观经济考虑，而不是为了保护某一个行业。

examples.en: Nothing in a macroeconomic forecast tells a small shop whether its own prices are too high.
examples.cn: 宏观经济预测里没有任何内容能告诉一家小店，它自己的定价是否过高。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「大」的前缀加「经济的」——把整个国家的经济合起来看 → 宏观经济的

root: 希腊 makros「长的、大的」+ oikonomikos（oikos「家宅」+ nemein「分配、管理」）→ 拉丁 oeconomicus → 英语 economic；二十世纪再加表示「大」的前缀，构成指整体经济层面的形容词。首见年份来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all keep one scale in view: the economy as a whole. From national totals the line moves to the policy levers used at that scale, to system modelling, to booms and slumps, to cross-country tables, to the statistics themselves, to risk that spreads through the system, and finally to forecasts built from those totals.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项始终守着同一个尺度：作为整体的经济。从全国总量出发，这条线依次走向该尺度上的政策杠杆、系统建模、繁荣与萧条、跨国对照表、统计本身、在系统内扩散的风险，最后落到由这些总量构建的预测。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an aerial view in which every shop and household becomes one number in a national total.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张俯瞰图，每间店铺与每户人家都变成一个全国总量里的数字。

branches.en: SCOPE AND LEVER: totals define the scale, and the same scale is where interest rates and budgets act.
branches.cn: 范围与杠杆：总量界定尺度，而利率与预算正是在同一尺度上起作用。

branches.en: SYSTEM AND CYCLE: sums that feed back into one another produce the long swings the word also names.
branches.cn: 系统与周期：互相反馈的总量产生长期摆动，这也在词义之内。

branches.en: COMPARISON AND COUNTING: national totals can be set beside other nations only because statistics produce them.
branches.cn: 比较与计量：全国总量之所以能与别国并排，是因为统计把它们生产出来。

branches.en: CONTAGION: scale turns local failure into a threat to every total on the page.
branches.cn: 扩散：尺度使局部的失灵变成对纸面上每一个总量的威胁。

branches.en: MODEL: the same scale names the forecasts and simulations built from national totals.
branches.cn: 模型：同一尺度也命名由全国总量构建的预测与模拟。

intro.en: The word can be read morpheme by morpheme: a Greek prefix for size, a Greek noun for the household, a Greek verb for managing, and an English suffix that turns the stem into an adjective.
intro.cn: 这个词可以按语素逐个读出：表示尺度的希腊前缀、指家宅的希腊名词、表示管理的希腊动词，以及把词干变成形容词的英语后缀。

latinIntro.en: Greek oikonomikos reached English through Latin oeconomicus; the Latin noun oeconomia and the agent noun oeconomus belong to the same estate-management family.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 oikonomikos 经拉丁 oeconomicus 进入英语；拉丁名词 oeconomia 与施事名词 oeconomus 同属家产管理这一词族。

definition_zh: n. 耳机；耳塞；（电话）听筒
definition_en: a small device worn in or over the ear that turns an electrical signal into sound for one listener

dict_mnemonic.text: earphone ＝ ear（耳朵，古英语 eare）＋ phone（声音，希腊语 phone）＝「送到耳朵的声音」。phone 家族按「声音送到哪」分：tele-（远）→ telephone 电话；head（头）→ headphone 头戴式耳机；ear（耳）→ earphone 耳机。日常说「一副耳机」用 a pair of earphones，因为左右两只配套；单只才说 an earphone。近义词 earbud 指塞在外耳道口的小耳塞，headset 多带一支话筒（set ＝ 一套），earpiece 与 receiver 偏电话听筒。注意 headphone 通常用复数 headphones，earphone 单复数都常见。

definition_zh: 立法机关；立法机构；（一国或一州的）议会
definition_en: the body of people in a state who have the power to make, amend or repeal laws
core_image: 一张长桌旁坐满人，桌上摊着同一份待表决的条文，末页的签名栏还空着
scene: 长桌两侧的人逐条念着一份草案，最后一页的签名栏仍然空着。 The state legislature passed the bill after a long night session.
sceneCN: 句中这个词指有权制定与修改法律的机构（第 1 个义项：由一批人组成、掌握立法权的机关）；句意为州立法机关经过一夜长会通过了该法案。图中可辨识物件：长桌、条文、空白签名栏、议席牌、表决灯。

pos.zh: 立法机关；立法机构（可数）
一国的立法部门（与行政、司法并列）

collocations.zh: 立法机关通过了该法案

senses.title: Lawmaking institution
senses.definition: a body with legal authority to make, change or repeal statutes
senses.definitionCN: 拥有制定、修改或废止成文法权的机构
senses.example: The state legislature passed the bill after a long night session.
senses.exampleCN: 州立法机关经过一夜长会通过了该法案。
senses.why: The word is built on legislator plus -ure, so it names the body through the activity of its members: carrying a law.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由 legislator 加 -ure 构成，因此它借成员的作为来命名机构：把法律搬运出去。

senses.title: A national assembly
senses.definition: the national lawmaking chamber of a country, often with a proper name
senses.definitionCN: 一国的国家级立法议院，常有专名
senses.example: The national legislature meets for two sessions a year.
senses.exampleCN: 国家立法机关每年开两次会。
senses.why: Once a body is named and housed, the general noun points to one particular chamber.
senses.whyCN: 一旦机构有了名称与院址，这个普通名词就指向某一个特定议院。

senses.title: A subnational lawmaking body
senses.definition: the lawmaking body of a state, province or territory within a larger union
senses.definitionCN: 联邦体制内州、省或地区的立法机构
senses.example: Education funding is decided by each provincial legislature.
senses.exampleCN: 教育经费由各省立法机关决定。
senses.why: A federation distributes lawmaking downward, so the same noun appears at a lower level with a narrower jurisdiction.
senses.whyCN: 联邦制把立法权向下分配，于是同一个名词出现在更低层级，管辖范围更窄。

senses.title: The legislative branch
senses.definition: the branch of government that stands beside the executive and the judiciary
senses.definitionCN: 与行政、司法并列的政府分支
senses.example: The constitution separates the legislature from the executive.
senses.exampleCN: 宪法把立法部门与行政部门分开。
senses.why: Separation of powers turns an assembly into one of three branches, and the word takes on that structural meaning.
senses.whyCN: 分权把议会变成三个分支之一，这个词就带上这一结构含义。

senses.title: The members collectively
senses.definition: the assembled members regarded as a single group with a will of its own
senses.definitionCN: 把全体成员当作一个有自身意志的群体
senses.example: The legislature rejected the amendment by a single vote.
senses.exampleCN: 全体议员以一票之差否决了修正案。
senses.why: An institution acts through votes, so the noun slides from the chamber to the people inside it.
senses.whyCN: 机构通过投票行动，于是这个名词从议院滑向里面的人。

senses.title: Colonial and territorial usage
senses.titleCN: 殖民地与准州的历史用法
senses.definition: the lawmaking body of a colony or territory that had limited self-rule
senses.definitionCN: 拥有有限自治权的殖民地或准州的立法机构
senses.example: The colonial legislature protested the new tax.
senses.exampleCN: 殖民地立法机关抗议这项新税。
senses.why: English usage gave the noun to assemblies that could make local law but not sovereign law.
senses.whyCN: 英语用法把这个名词给了能立地方法、却不能立主权法律的议会。

senses.title: A rule-setting body in any organisation
senses.titleCN: 任何组织内部的规则制定机构
senses.definition: a committee or assembly that writes the binding rules of a club, union or company
senses.definitionCN: 为社团、工会或公司制定约束性规则的委员会或大会
senses.example: The union's legislature meets to rewrite the bylaws.
senses.exampleCN: 工会的规则制定机构开会改写章程。
senses.why: Making binding rules is the function, so any body doing it can borrow the name.
senses.whyCN: 制定有约束力的规则是这项职能，任何做这件事的机构都能借用这个名称。

senses.title: Lawmaking authority itself
senses.definition: the power to enact law, considered apart from the body that holds it
senses.definitionCN: 与持有它的机构分开来看的立法权力
senses.example: The treaty left customs law to the domestic legislature.
senses.exampleCN: 该条约把海关立法权留给本国立法机关。
senses.why: English often uses an institution's name for its power, so the word can name an authority rather than a room.
senses.whyCN: 英语常用机构名代指其权力，因此这个词可以指一种权限，而非一间议事厅。

intro.en: Legislature is recorded from the 1670s as legislator plus -ure. The Latin base is legis lator 'proposer of a law', from lex 'law' and lator 'bearer', the latter tied to ferre 'to carry'.
intro.cn: legislature 自十七世纪七十年代见于记录，由 legislator 加 -ure 构成。其拉丁基础是 legis lator「提出法律的人」，来自 lex「法律」与 lator「搬运者」，后者与 ferre「搬运」相关。

items.en: Lex, genitive legis, meant 'law, statute'. Its deeper origin is uncertain, and the often-suggested link to legere 'to gather, read' is a hypothesis rather than a demonstrated derivation.
items.cn: lex（属格 legis）意为「法律、法令」。其更深来源不确定，常被提出的与 legere「收集、读」的联系只是假说，并非已证实的派生。

items.en: Ferre 'to carry' supplied the participle latus 'borne', which was used as its past participle and also appears in translate and relate.
items.cn: ferre「搬运」提供分词 latus「被搬运的」，它被当作过去分词使用，也出现在 translate 与 relate 中。

items.en: The phrase legis lator meant 'one who brings or proposes a law'; lator is the agent noun of the carried form, so a lawmaker is literally a law-bearer.
items.cn: 短语 legis lator 意为「把法律带来或提出的人」；lator 是「搬运」这一动作的施事名词，因此立法者字面上就是「搬运法律的人」。

items.en: English legislator is recorded about 1600, and in American usage it came to mean a member of a state or territorial body.
items.cn: 英语 legislator 约在 1600 年见于记录；在美式用法中，它指州或准州立法机关的成员。

items.en: The noun legislature was formed with the suffix -ure, which names an office or a result, and was applied to the body rather than to one member.
items.cn: 名词 legislature 以 -ure 词尾构成，该词尾命名职务或结果，并用在机构而非单个成员上。

items.en: Source uncertain for the pre-Latin origin of lex; the link to legere is only a hypothesis, and the date 1670s is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定之处是 lex 在拉丁语之前的来源；与 legere 的联系仅为假说，1670 年代也是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words built on lex 'law' and on the look-alike legere 'to read or choose', which are constantly confused; group two holds bodies that also deliberate and decide.
note.cn: 第一组包括由 lex「法律」构成的词，以及形似而实出 legere「读、选」的词，二者极易混淆；第二组是同样议事并作决定的机构。

entries.definition: The statutes produced by a legislature, or the act of making them; it names output, not the body.
entries.definitionCN: 指立法机关产出的法规，或立法这一行为；命名的是成果，不是机构。

entries.definition: Relating to lawmaking or to a legislature; it describes a power or a session, not an institution.
entries.definitionCN: 指与立法或立法机关有关的；它描述一种权力或一场会议，而非机构。

entries.definition: A single person who helps make laws; the suffix -or marks the doer where -ure marks the body.
entries.definitionCN: 指参与制定法律的单个人；词尾 -or 标记施事者，而 -ure 标记机构。

entries.definition: Able to be read, from legere 'to read'; it looks like the law family but has nothing to do with lex.
entries.definitionCN: 指可读的，出自 legere「读」；它看起来像法律词族，但与 lex 无关。

entries.definition: A national legislature, especially in a system where the executive is drawn from it; the name comes from speaking, not from law.
entries.definitionCN: 指国家立法机关，尤其在行政由其中产生的体制里；其名称来自「说话」，而非「法律」。

entries.definition: A national legislature, especially the American one; its name comes from walking together, not from law.
entries.definitionCN: 指国家立法机关，尤指美国国会；其名称来自「走到一起」，而非「法律」。

entries.definition: Any gathering of people for a purpose, including a lawmaking one; it is the broad word that legislature narrows.
entries.definitionCN: 指为某种目的聚集的人，包括立法性集会；它是 legislature 所收窄的宽泛词。

entries.definition: A body that advises or administers rather than makes statute law; it deliberates, but its decisions are usually not statutes.
entries.definitionCN: 指提供建议或进行行政管理的机构，而非制定成文法的机构；它也议事，但决定通常不是法规。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin phrase, the real family of law words and the real political phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁短语、真实的法字词族与真实的政治搭配。

normal.en: legis 'of law' plus lator 'bearer': the body where laws are carried through.
normal.cn: legis「法律的」加 lator「搬运者」：法律在那里被搬运通过的机构。

normal.en: The family runs legislate, legislation, legislative, legislator and legislature.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 legislate、legislation、legislative、legislator 与 legislature。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the institution: state legislature, national legislature, member of the legislature.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出机构用法：州立法机关、国家立法机关、立法机关成员。

normal.en: The -ure ending marks a body or office, as in judicature and prefecture.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ure 标记机构或职务，如 judicature 与 prefecture。

normal.en: The law root lex is not the reading root legere: elect and legible belong elsewhere.
normal.cn: 法律词根 lex 不是「读」的词根 legere：elect 与 legible 属于另一支。

abstract.en: Picture a long table where a single sheet travels from hand to hand until every hand has touched it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张长桌，一张纸从一只手传到另一只手，直到每只手都碰过它。

abstract.en: Picture three doors in one wall, and only one of them opens onto a printing press.
abstract.cn: 想象一面墙上有三扇门，只有一扇通向印刷机。

abstract.en: Picture a rulebook that is rewritten by the players while the game is running.
abstract.cn: 想象一本规则书由球员在比赛进行时改写。

examples.en: The legislature voted to raise the minimum age for driving.
examples.cn: 立法机关投票提高了驾驶的最低年龄。

examples.en: A territorial legislature governed the region before statehood.
examples.cn: 建州之前，这个地区由准州立法机关治理。

examples.en: The governor can veto bills passed by the legislature.
examples.cn: 州长可以否决立法机关通过的法案。

root: 拉丁 legis lator「法律的提出者」= lex（属格 legis）「法律」+ lator「搬运者」（与 ferre「搬运」相关）；英语加 -ure 构成机构名。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one room: a body carries a bill into law, then is seen as a national chamber, a local chamber, a branch, a group of people, a colonial body, any rule-setter and finally the bare authority to legislate.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕同一间议事厅展开：一个机构把草案搬运成法律；随后它被看作国家议院、地方议院、政府分支、一群议员、殖民地机构、任何规则制定者，最后只剩立法权限本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long table with one sheet of clauses moving from hand to hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张长桌，一页条文从一只手传到另一只手。

branches.en: BODY AND POWER: the room and its authority are named by the same word, one concrete and one abstract.
branches.cn: 机构与权限：议事厅与其权限由同一个词命名，一具体一抽象。

branches.en: TWO LEVELS: a federation repeats the same chamber at national and provincial scale.
branches.cn: 两个层级：联邦制在国家与省级重复同一个议院。

branches.en: STRUCTURE AND PERSONS: a branch of government acts only through the votes of the people inside it.
branches.cn: 结构与人员：政府分支只能通过里面那些人的投票来行动。

branches.en: THE COLONY: limited self-rule produces a chamber that can make local law but not sovereign law.
branches.cn: 殖民地：有限的自治产生一个能立地方法、不能立主权法律的议院。

branches.en: THE BORROWED NAME: any body that writes binding rules can take the title.
branches.cn: 借来的名称：任何制定约束性规则的机构都能取用这个称号。

intro.en: Legislature joins a Latin law-noun, a Latin agent noun and an English suffix of office, so its family can be read piece by piece.
intro.cn: legislature 连接一个拉丁法律名词、一个拉丁施事名词和一个表职务的英语词尾，因此其词族可以逐块读出。

latinIntro.en: Lex supplies legal and legislation; lator and its base ferre supply translate, relate and oblate; -ure marks an office or result.
latinIntro.cn: lex 提供 legal 与 legislation；lator 及其基础 ferre 提供 translate、relate 与 oblate；-ure 标记职务或结果。

items.example: The root names the thing the body produces.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根命名机构所产出的东西。

items.example: The agent noun names the person who brings the law.
items.exampleCN: 这个施事名词命名把法律带来的人。

items.example: The legislator read the clause aloud.
The chamber legislates for the whole province.

items.meaning: the making of laws; the laws made
items.example: The legislation took effect in spring.
The same ending appears in judicature.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾出现在 judicature 中。

items.example: The ending marks the person rather than the body.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾标记人，而非机构。
